evidence_and_state_review.privacy_identity: The current DTO exposes vin_masked, not raw VIN; MaskVIN reveals only WMI/tail for sufficiently long identifiers and fully masks short ones. No real identity was inspected. Export retains current raw response facts; no new public/share endpoint or redaction guarantee for hypothetical added fields is inferred.
evidence_and_state_review.provenance: The matrix matches seven ordered tsbp-v1 inputs, UTC-day timestamps and fixed-four-decimal backend serialization. VIN mask, reference capacity, thermal, grade, trend and recommendations are explicitly not hash-bound. A match is described as current digest agreement, not telemetry correctness, regulatory certification, safety or remaining life.
evidence_and_state_review.capacity_soh: Capacity is the median of up to eight qualifying daily energy/SoC estimates against a server-selected reference. SoH=0 with grade=N/A is explicitly treated as unavailable; numerical capacity handling still has finding F03. Grade thresholds/penalties and fit gates correspond to server/source calculations.
evidence_and_state_review.SI_display_exceptions: Current backend contract explicitly returns capacity_kwh/original_capacity_kwh and the v1 digest binds capacity_kwh. These existing wire identifiers, formula keys, tsbp-v1, N/A and verbatim rule outputs are technical/evidence exceptions, not newly introduced SI fields or hardcoded UI-label findings. No legacy conversion helper was called or requested. A future wire-unit change requires its actual integration owner and hash-version policy; this report does not rename it.
evidence_and_state_review.denominators: Trend shares use included displayed points and become null with zero points. Thermal shares use drives with ambient readings; fast-share uses all counted charging sessions; end-SoC uses non-null end_soc_pct records. Session/reading totals are absent from the current DTO; candidate C01 remains integration uncertainty rather than a fabricated measured-zero failure.
evidence_and_state_review.date_timezone: Trend day parsing preserves explicit UTC calendar keys, sorts/deduplicates with exact exclusion categories and uses one immutable mount clock. Masthead instants use the selected vehicle timezone; freshness in the KPI brief does not share it (F06). Range controls are intentionally absent for this cumulative/current contract.
evidence_and_state_review.loading_pending_empty: No vehicle disables both queries. Local skeleton/status surfaces handle initial loading. Undefined and null responses remain distinct. Empty certificate success disables export while retaining every shell. Paused initial/empty states are described as paused/pending without inventing connectivity or empty-source causes.
evidence_and_state_review.fatal_retained_recovery: Initial certificate failure has masthead QueryError retry. Retained certificate failure preserves facts/export and warns, but offers no retry (F04). Verification loading, refreshing, mismatch and error do not erase certificate evidence; verification failure has no independent retry (F05). Offline-paused retained certificate uses existing StaleRefreshWarning recovery; it must not be confused with failed refresh recovery.
evidence_and_state_review.malformed: Source guards Array.isArray for trend/recommendations, checks finite/ranged diagnostics, invalid/future/duplicate dates and thermal totals, and retains unmodified export facts. Existing malformed synthetic fixture declarations were read, not executed. Hypothetical non-string/object wire violations were not promoted to findings.
evidence_and_state_review.exports_live_replay: Export is local canonical JSON from retained raw facts; strips client-added camel mirrors recursively, preserves returned order/unknown fields, and revokes the object URL. Copy/export make no vehicle command or POST/PUT/DELETE. There is no operational mutation on this page; GET passport has a documented best-effort server ledger append. QueryClient prevents offline mutation replay, but as_of capability/disclosure remains C02.
evidence_and_state_review.i18n: All 296 referenced batteryPassport keys exist in both inspected English source catalogs. Paused also exists. Verbatim server outputs and technical field identifiers are retained intentionally. Actual locale/catalog loading and translations were NOTRUN.
evidence_and_state_review.source_a11y_mobile: Localized action names, native shared buttons, section status labels, chart alternative inputs, wrap/stack grids and field-directory keyValue detail roles are present in source. Provenance source/meaning is hidden without mobile recovery (F01). Distribution progressbars falsely announce zero on an empty denominator (F02). Computed focus/contrast/target sizes, screen readers and mobile drawer reachability are NOTRUN, not passed.

findings.title: Provenance source/meaning column is unreachable below md
evidence: web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportProvenanceMatrix.tsx:277-285 defines source/meaning; 328-336 disables column visibility/reorder and supplies only field/value/binding mobileColumns.
web\src\components\ui\DataTable.tsx:742-743 maps omitted mobile keys to hidden md:table-cell; 1173-1181 applies that class to cells.
The provenance caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expansion/details; unlike the field directory it has no narrow-screen route to this column.
findings.mechanism: At viewport widths below 768px, the source column's content is display:none. Horizontal scrolling cannot reveal display:none cells, and the disabled column menu cannot restore them. This deterministically removes provenance interpretation metadata from that section.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: Only BatteryPassportProvenanceMatrix and its named matching test: reuse existing mobile keyValue/details presentation or preserve the complete column through contained scrolling; do not change DataTable globally.

findings.title: Empty trend denominators become measured-zero accessible bars
evidence: web\src\features\battery\lib\batteryPassportAnalysis.ts:386-390 returns share=null when points.length is zero.
web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportTrendDistribution.tsx:77 substitutes zero; 80-89 separately shows an em dash.
web\src\components\data-display\MetricBar.tsx:49-63 treats finite zero as a reading and emits aria-valuenow=0 instead of its missing-reading aria-valuetext.
findings.mechanism: A valid certificate with degradation_trend=[] retains this section. All five shares have no denominator, yet every progressbar exposes a known zero percentage to assistive technology while its visible sublabel says unknown. This needs no malformed response.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: BatteryPassportTrendDistribution and a named regression only: pass null for null share and preserve genuine zero shares when the included-point denominator is positive; use the existing MetricBar missing-value API.

findings.title: Unavailable capacity estimate is rendered as zero capacity and zero ratio
evidence: internal\api\batterypassport\scoring.go:163-165 returns zero for an empty capacity sample; handler.go:355 uses this median; 291-294 leaves the grade N/A without positive SoH.

web\src\features\battery\lib\batteryPassportAnalysis.ts:609-618 suppresses the explicit unavailable SoH sentinel but accepts capacity_kwh=0 as a finite estimate; 651-655 computes a zero capacity/reference quotient.
web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportCapacityContext.tsx:43-49,88-90 and BatteryPassportKpiBand.tsx:43-46 display these numbers as the reported estimate/ratio.
findings.mechanism: The conforming no-qualifying-estimate response has soh_pct=0, health_grade=N/A and capacity_kwh=0. SoH correctly appears unavailable, but the capacity panels still present 0 kWh and 0% rather than distinguishing the backend's no-sample sentinel from an actual estimate. This is not a wire rename or a request to erase valid zero facts.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: batteryPassportAnalysis and named capacity/KPI regressions: derive unavailable estimated capacity from the documented no-estimate sentinel while retaining raw zero in the field/hash/export evidence; preserve valid zero semantics elsewhere.

findings.title: Retained failed certificate refresh has no user retry
evidence: web\src\features\battery\pages\BatteryPassportPage.tsx:212-225 supplies onRetry=passportQuery.refetch.

web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportMasthead.tsx:342-355 renders only warning text with a retained passport. QueryError retry occurs only at 209-214 or the empty-response error branch 357-363.

web\src\features\battery\pages\BatteryPassportPage.tsx:314 excludes StaleRefreshWarning whenever refreshError exists; queryClient.ts:51 disables refetchOnWindowFocus and the passport hook defines no polling.
findings.mechanism: After a populated certificate exhausts refresh retries, its facts are correctly retained but the available onRetry callback is never attached to the failed-refresh surface. Paused/offline recovery has a separate button; that does not recover this failed-refresh branch.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: BatteryPassportMasthead and its named retained-refresh regression: expose the existing state.onRetry beside the nonblocking warning, without hiding facts or duplicating fatal recovery.

findings.title: Failed verification has no independent recovery action
evidence: web\src\features\battery\pages\BatteryPassportPage.tsx:149-153 owns verifyQuery but 234-291 creates only status/data/error.
web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\types.ts:24-28 carries no verify retry callback.
web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportVerificationDiagnostics.tsx:85-94 labels the error unavailable; its body has no recovery control.
The certificate retry at BatteryPassportPage.tsx:214 refetches only passportQuery; an unchanged hash does not change the verification key.
findings.mechanism: A verification-only network failure leaves the certificate usable but cannot be retried directly by the user. Even retrying the certificate would not necessarily retry verification if the seven bound facts/hash remain unchanged. Independent source recovery is missing, not certificate evidence.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: BatteryPassportPage, passport verification state type and BatteryPassportVerificationDiagnostics plus a named regression: carry verifyQuery.refetch to a localized nonblocking retry; do not widen backend capabilities.

findings.title: KPI freshness silently uses browser timezone instead of certificate display context
evidence: web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportKpiBand.tsx:93-96 passes issued_at as the snapshot observedAt.
web\src\features\battery\components\operationalbrief-all\BatteryEvidenceBrief.tsx:53 calls formatDateTime without locale/timezone options.
web\src\lib\dateFormat.ts:54-61 then uses browser locale/timezone.

web\src\features\battery\pages\BatteryPassportPage.tsx:133,342 and web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportMasthead.tsx:264-269 render the same certificate issue instant in vehicle time with i18n locale.
findings.mechanism: For a browser in a different timezone or locale, the same issue instant is presented differently in the identity and KPI freshness surfaces; the KPI freshness has no timezone indicator. Source signatures make this divergence deterministic without inspecting any real timestamp.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: Passport KPI timestamp presentation at its existing owner; use existing date/time display APIs and explicit context. If BatteryEvidenceBrief needs an optional context prop, its actual shared owner must receive a separate parent claim; no global default changes.

findings.title: Decorative rainbow stripe and fixed series/bar colors bypass restrained theme roles
evidence: web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportMasthead.tsx:149 adds a non-data emerald/cyan/purple gradient stripe.
web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportTrendTimeline.tsx:108 and BatteryPassportTrendDistribution.tsx:79 force #22d3ee.
web\src\features\battery\components\battery-passport\BatteryPassportThermalProfile.tsx:53,55,57 selects three fixed hex colors.
web\src\components\charts\AreaChartWrapper.tsx:111-112,161 uses the supplied color directly for tint/stroke, not the saved palette.
findings.mechanism: The masthead decoration has no semantic meaning. Data fills/strokes are fixed regardless of theme or saved palette, contrary to MDC-010/034 and mission color restraint. This establishes source bypass, not a measured contrast failure.
findings.minimal_follow_up_scope: Only the four named passport rendering components and their matching regressions: remove the decorative stripe and consume existing semantic/palette roles; retain band identities, source values and user preference IDs.

unconfirmed_candidates.title: Charging-share/end-SoC zero defaults lack denominator provenance
unconfirmed_candidates.reason_not_promoted: The backend defaults absent rollups to zero, but the wire omits total session/end-SoC reading counts. A valid returned zero can be genuine; source-only inspection cannot infer missing denominators for an arbitrary displayed certificate. Existing fixtures intentionally preserve zero proxies.
unconfirmed_candidates.bounded_follow_up: Actual passport integration owner may specify nullable aggregate evidence/counts or explicit unavailability provenance, then add focused contract/page regressions. Never blanket-convert zero to unknown.

unconfirmed_candidates.title: Current certificate scope under global as_of banner needs capability disclosure
unconfirmed_candidates.reason_not_promoted: The hooks intentionally read a current certificate, not as_of state, and page labels repeatedly say current. The global banner describes historical mode while the current GET can append its documented ledger snapshot. This is an integration/disclosure question, not an observed replay failure or a client operational mutation. Local JSON/copy actions do not require live vehicle-write guards.
unconfirmed_candidates.bounded_follow_up: Route capability/disclosure owner should define the current-only passport boundary in historical navigation; do not invent date-bounded/passport replay backend support.
